title: Switch saved commanders without carrying unsent market intent
description: Four saved commanders enter a real development campaign. Ordinary sign-out/sign-in reuses one browser across two accounts without resaving either identity. Partial unsent market intent must clear, while canonical state, both private projections and receipt sets remain unchanged. Fixed admission/catalogue clocks and developer entitlement are explicit harness controls. This does not claim durable accepted-order recovery or hosted authentication acceptance.
